card.name: Words completing a clinical instruction phrase
card.fires_on: Short words in the middle of a label instruction, such as 'be' in 'may be switched', 'their' before 'health care provider' or 'prescriber', and '-base' after 'acid'.

modes.label: their before provider
modes.description: The word 'their' before a health care provider or prescriber in patient-contact instructions.
modes.example: the patient should contact<< their>> health care provider immediately.

modes.label: Linking word mid-instruction
modes.description: A short verb or hyphen part inside a switching or monitoring instruction.
modes.example: the patient may<< be>> switched to Levetiracetam oral

modes.label: Partway through a term
modes.description: A piece inside a clinical term such as acid-base, INR or intubation.
modes.example: frequent monitoring of acid<<-base>> balance is necessary.
